question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The police officer is looking _____ the matter to find the real culprit.
explanation: 'Look into' ek phrasal verb hai jiska matlab kisi chij ki jaanch padtaal karna (investigate) hota hai. Context ke hisaab se investigation ho rahi hai isliye 'into' sahi hai.
trick: 'Look' ke sath alag-alag prepositions milkar nayi meaning banate hain, jaise 'look into' = investigate.
tip: Phrasal verbs ke fixed meanings exam ke liye yaad rakhein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Neither the students nor the teacher _____ present in the classroom today.
explanation: Grammar rule ke mutabiq, jab do subjects 'neither...nor' se jude hote hain, toh verb hamesha uske nazdeek wale subject ke according aati hai. Yahan nazdeek wala subject 'teacher' singular hai, isliye 'is' aayega.
trick: 'Neither...nor', 'Either...or' mein verb hamesha second ya paas wale subject ke hisaab se lagta hai.
tip: Verb ke sabse najdeek wale subject ko check karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The new government policy will certainly _____ the entire farming community.
explanation: Sentence mein modal verb 'will' ke baad base verb (v1) chahiye. 'Affect' ek verb hai jiska matlab prabhavit karna hota hai, jabki 'effect' ek noun hai jiska matlab prabhav (result) hota hai.
trick: Agar action ki baat ho toh 'affect' (verb) chunein, agar result ki baat ho toh 'effect' (noun).
tip: A se affect (Action), E se effect (End result).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Rakesh is _____ honest man who never lies to his colleagues.
explanation: Word 'honest' mein 'h' silent hota hai aur pronunciation 'o' se shuru hoti hai jo ek vowel sound hai. Vowel sound se pehle hamesha article 'an' lagta hai.
trick: Article lagate waqt word ka spelling nahi, uska pronunciation (sound) check karo.
tip: Hindi swar (a, aa, i, e) sound par 'an' lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Hardly had I reached the railway station _____ the train left.
explanation: English grammar mein 'Hardly' aur 'Scarcely' ke sath hamesha conjunction 'when' ka use hota hai. 'Than' ka use comparative degree ya 'No sooner' ke sath hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'Hardly' dikhte hi options mein 'when' ko dhundo, ye fixed pair hai.
tip: Co-relative pairs yaad rakhein: Hardly/Scarcely + when.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: She has been living in this city _____ 2015.
explanation: Present Perfect Continuous tense mein point of time (fixed year, month, day) batane ke liye 'since' ka use hota hai. 'For' ka use duration (jaise 5 years) batane ke liye hota hai.
trick: Jab fixed saal (2015), mahina ya din diya ho, toh directly 'since' tick karein.
tip: Point of time = Since, Period of time = For.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The invigilator asked the students to _____ from talking during the examination.
explanation: 'Refrain' ke sath hamesha fixed preposition 'from' aata hai jiska matlab kisi kaam ko karne se rukna ya bachna hota hai. Baaki options context mein fit nahi baithte.
trick: Blank ke baad 'from' likha hai, 'refrain' aur 'abstain' dono ke sath 'from' hi aata hai.
tip: Refrain aur abstain ke sath hamesha from lagta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: I _____ my homework before my father came back from the office.
explanation: Jab past mein do actions ek ke baad ek hote hain, toh pehla complete hone wala action Past Perfect (had + v3) mein hota hai aur dusra Simple Past (v2) mein. Homework pehle finish hua tha.
trick: 'Before' ke baad wala part agar v2 (came) hai, toh usse pehle wala part 'had + v3' hoga.
tip: Past ka past = Past Perfect Tense (had + v3).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Rohan is much superior _____ his brother in terms of technical knowledge.
explanation: Latin adjectives jo '-ior' par khatam hote hain (jaise superior, inferior, junior, senior), unke baad comparison ke liye 'than' nahi, balki 'to' preposition ka use hota hai.
trick: Jin comparative words ke end mein 'ior' aata hai, wahan aankh band karke 'to' lagayein.
tip: Superior, inferior, senior, junior ke sath hamesha 'to' aata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: If it rains heavily tomorrow, we _____ the cricket match.
explanation: Ye ek First Conditional sentence hai. Rule ke hisaab se, if-clause Present Simple (rains) mein hota hai aur main clause Future Simple (will/shall + v1) mein hota hai.
trick: If ke baad wala verb check karo. Agar present (v1/v5) hai, toh dusri side 'will + v1' aayega.
tip: If + Present Simple = Future Simple (will/shall + v1).

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The manager was _____ to find that the project was completed _____ schedule.
explanation: Project time par pura hone par manager khush hoga, isliye positive word 'thrilled' aayega. Aur time par hone ke liye fixed phrase 'on schedule' hota hai.
trick: Second blank mein preposition check karein, 'on schedule' ek fixed English phrase hai.
tip: Positive situation ke liye positive emotion (thrilled) chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Despite being very _____, the old man was _____ to lift the heavy suitcase.
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast ya virodhabhas dikhata hai. Agar wo kamzor (weak) tha, toh aam taur par suitcase utha nahi pata, par contrast ki wajah se wo utha paya (able).
trick: 'Despite' opposite ideas ko jodta hai. Pehla blank negative (weak) toh dusra positive (able) hoga.
tip: Despite contrast banata hai (Negative-Positive pattern).

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: She _____ to the supermarket to buy some _____ vegetables for dinner.
explanation: 'She' ke sath 'go' nahi aa sakta (goes ya went aayega). Dinner ke liye sabziyan 'fresh' hi kharidi jayengi, 'rotten' (sadi hui) nahi. Isliye 'went, fresh' sahi pair hai.
trick: Sabziyon ke liye positive adjective chahiye, isliye rotten aur spoiled automatically eliminate ho jate hain.
tip: Subject ke according verb tense aur logical adjective chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Many students were _____ by the unexpected difficulty _____ the mathematics exam.
explanation: Exam ke difficult hone par students ko shock lagega. Dusre blank mein, kisi chij ki difficulty dikhane ke liye 'difficulty of something' format use hota hai.
trick: Difficulty ke baad noun aaye toh 'of' lagta hai. Second blank dekhte hi baaki options hat jayenge.
tip: Sentence ke tone (difficult exam) se emotion guess karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: He is not _____ enough to _____ this highly complex puzzle.
explanation: Sentence ke last mein 'complex puzzle' diya hai. Puzzle ko 'solve' kiya jata hai aur uske liye 'smart' hone ki zaroorat hoti hai. Baaki pairs contextless hain.
trick: Double fillers mein pehle dusra blank check karein, puzzle ke sath 'solve' word easily match kar raha hai.
tip: Object (puzzle) aur uske related verb (solve) ko jodein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The software company decided to _____ new staff because of the massive _____ in demand for their product.
explanation: Jab kisi product ki demand badhti hai (increase), toh company ko naye log rakhne (hire) padte hain. Cause and effect relation bilkul clear hai.
trick: Reason aur result dekhein. Demand badhegi toh naye log fire ya suspend thodi honge, hire honge.
tip: Sentence mein reason aur uske logical result ko match karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: _____ he was extremely tired, he _____ working on his assignment late into the night.
explanation: Sentence ke dono parts opposite idea de rahe hain. Thaka hua tha, fir bhi kaam karta raha. Aise contrast dikhane ke liye 'Although' aur 'kept working' sahi combination hai.
trick: Contrast (virodhabhas) dikhane ke liye pehle blank mein 'Although' ya 'Though' sabse best option hota hai.
tip: Virodhabhas wale sentences mein conjunction 'Although' use karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The old king was universally known for his _____ and he treated all his subjects _____.
explanation: Conjunction 'and' do similar ideas ya tones ko jodta hai. Raja ke bare mein universally achhi baat ho rahi hai toh kindness (dayalu) aur well (achhi tarah) positive pair banate hain.
trick: 'And' ke dono taraf tone match karein. Positive word ke sath positive word hi aayega.
tip: 'And' hamesha same tone (positive/negative) wale words jodta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The airline apologized _____ the flight delay and offered passengers a _____ on their next booking.
explanation: Apologize ke baad reason batane ke liye 'for' aata hai (apologize for the delay). Dusre blank mein, delay ke compensation ke roop mein company 'discount' deti hai, warning ya penalty nahi.
trick: Pehla blank 'apologize for' se asani se solve ho jata hai. Galti ki maafi mangne ke sath 'for' lagta hai.
tip: Apologize + for + mistake/reason.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The sudden _____ of the massive storm left everyone in a state of sheer _____.
explanation: Achanak toofan aane (arrival) se logo mein dar ya ghabrahat (panic) phel jati hai. Storm negative word hai isliye dono blanks ka combination isi tone mein hona chahiye.
trick: Storm (toofan) se negative impact padta hai, isliye options mein se wo pair chunein jo danger ya dar (panic) dikhaye.
tip: Negative event (storm) ke liye negative reaction (panic) chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The children are very fond _____ playing cricket in the evening.
explanation: 'Fond' ke sath hamesha fixed preposition 'of' lagta hai jiska matlab shaukeen hona hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'fond' dikhe toh options mein direct 'of' dhundo.
tip: Fond of = shaukeen hona.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The captain, along with his teammates, _____ going to the stadium.
explanation: Jab do subjects 'along with', 'as well as' ya 'with' se jude ho, toh verb hamesha pehle subject (captain) ke according lagti hai. Captain singular hai isliye 'is' aayega.
trick: 'Along with' se pehle wala word dekho, wahi real subject hota hai.
tip: Verb hamesha pehle subject ke according lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: No sooner had the thief seen the police _____ he ran away.
explanation: 'No sooner' ek co-relative conjunction hai jiske sath hamesha 'than' ka use hota hai. Baaki options grammatical error banate hain.
trick: 'No sooner' mein 'er' laga hai (comparative degree jaisa), isliye iske sath hamesha 'than' aayega.
tip: No sooner + than, Hardly/Scarcely + when.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: My brother recently met _____ European tourist in Delhi.
explanation: 'European' word 'E' se shuru hota hai par iska pronunciation 'Y' (yu) se hota hai jo consonant (vyanjan) sound hai. Consonant sound ke pehle 'a' lagta hai.
trick: Vowel letter (A, E, I, O, U) par mat jao, Hindi swar ka sound check karo.
tip: 'Yu' sound ke pehle 'a' lagta hai, 'an' nahi.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The heavy rain prevented us _____ going to the picnic.
explanation: 'Prevent' (rokna) ke baad hamesha fixed preposition 'from' aata hai aur uske baad aane wali verb hamesha ing form (gerund) mein hoti hai.
trick: Prevent, prohibit, abstain jaise rokne wale words ke sath hamesha 'from' lagta hai.
tip: Prevent + from + V4(ing).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: If I _____ the Prime Minister, I would eradicate poverty completely.
explanation: Imaginary ya unreal situation (jo sach nahi hai) batane ke liye sabhi subjects (I, he, she, it) ke sath hamesha 'were' ka use hota hai.
trick: 'If I' ke baad kisi imaginary post ya condition ki baat ho toh aankh band karke 'were' lagayein.
tip: Imaginary sentences mein hamesha 'were' use hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: He _____ in this reputed company for the last ten years.
explanation: Jab 'for/since + time' diya ho aur koi kaam past se shuru ho kar abhi bhi chal raha ho, toh wahan Present Perfect Continuous tense (has/have been + ing) aata hai.
trick: Sentence ke last mein 'for + last ten years' dekhte hi samajh jao ki 'has/have been' wala option aayega.
tip: Since/For + Time = Perfect Continuous Tense.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The young man was accused _____ stealing the precious diamond necklace.
explanation: 'Accused' (aaropi hona) ke sath English grammar mein hamesha fixed preposition 'of' ka use kiya jata hai. Iska matlab hota hai kisi apraadh ka aarop lagna.
trick: Crime ya blame ke liye 'accused' aur 'guilty' dono words ke sath hamesha 'of' lagta hai.
tip: Accused of aur Guilty of, dono fixed phrases hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The strict teacher made the students _____ outside the class in the sun.
explanation: Causative verb 'make' (yahan made) ke baad active voice mein hamesha bare infinitive aata hai, yaani verb ki first form bina 'to' ke lagti hai.
trick: Make, Let aur Bid ke baad hamesha sirf v1 lagta hai, inke sath 'to v1' (infinitive) ka use galat hota hai.
tip: Let aur Make ke sath hamesha V1 (bare infinitive) aata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The clever lawyer tried his best to _____ the hidden truth from the nervous witness.
explanation: 'Elicit' ek verb hai jiska matlab sachai ya information bahar nikalwana hota hai. 'Illicit' ka matlab illegal (gair-kanooni) hota hai jo yahan fit nahi hoga.
trick: E se Elicit (Extract/nikalna), I se Illicit (Illegal). Truth hamesha extract kiya jata hai.
tip: Meaning yaad rakhein: Elicit = nikalwana, Illicit = illegal.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Not only the principal _____ the teachers are attending the annual school meeting.
explanation: Grammar ka rule hai ki 'Not only' ke sath hamesha pair mein 'but also' ka hi use kiya jata hai. (Note: The prompt asks for pair of words, but since it's a conjunction pair filling a single grammatical function conceptually, 'but also' is the key phrase).
trick: Sentence mein 'Not only' dhundo aur sidha 'but also' wale option par jao.
tip: Not only + but also ek fixed pair hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: _____ she was terribly ill, _____ she completed her pending assignment on time.
explanation: Jab do baaton mein virodh (contrast) ho, tab 'Although' (halanki) aur uske sath 'yet' (fir bhi) ka pair lagta hai. Bimari ke bawajood kaam pura kiya gaya hai.
trick: Contrast wale sentence mein 'Although' ke sath hamesha 'yet' ya comma (,) aata hai, 'but' kabhi nahi aayega.
tip: Although/Though ke sath hamesha yet lagta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The corrupt officer was forced to _____ from his prominent post due to intense political _____.
explanation: Corrupt officer ko uski post chhodne par majboor (forced) kiya jayega. Political pressure ke karan hi log post se 'resign' karte hain. Dusre options positive context ke hain.
trick: Sentence mein 'corrupt' aur 'forced' negative words hain, isliye aapke dono words bhi negative tone wale hone chahiye (resign, pressure).
tip: Sentence ki tone negative hai, negative words hi chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Due to the _____ fog on the main highway, many trains and buses were heavily _____.
explanation: Kohra (fog) gaadha (dense/thick) hota hai jisse vehicles ki speed slow hoti hai aur transport late (delayed) ho jata hai. Ye ek natural cause aur effect hai.
trick: Fog ke liye English mein 'dense' adjective ka use hota hai, aur fog ki wajah se flights/trains hamesha 'delayed' hoti hain.
tip: Fog ke sath hamesha 'dense' adjective lagta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: If you do not work _____, you will surely _____ in the upcoming final examination.
explanation: Sentence ek condition bata raha hai ki agar mehnat (work hard) nahi karoge, toh uska result negative aayega yaani fail ho jaoge.
trick: 'Do not' laga hai, iska matlab agar achha kaam nahi karoge toh result bura (fail) milega. 'Hard' aur 'fail' sabse logical pair hain.
tip: Cause and effect ko logical context mein set karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The notorious criminal was immediately _____ by the alert police for _____ illegal drugs across the border.
explanation: Criminals ko police arrest karti hai aur border ke aar-paar gair-kanooni chijein le jana smuggling kehlata hai.
trick: Criminal aur police ke relation mein pehla word 'arrested' aayega, dusra blank (smuggling) apne aap set ho jayega.
tip: Police criminal ko hamesha arrest karti hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The elderly patient was _____ from a severe viral infection, so the chief doctor _____ some strong antibiotics.
explanation: Bimari se peedit hone ke liye 'suffering from' lagta hai aur doctor dwara dawai likhne ki process ko 'prescribe' karna kehte hain.
trick: 'From' se pehle illness ke liye 'suffering' lagta hai aur yaad rakho ki doctor dawai bechta nahi, 'prescribe' karta hai.
tip: Suffering from illness aur doctor hamesha prescribe karta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: After the national team finally _____ the historic world cup, the entire nation _____ with great enthusiasm.
explanation: Sentence ke aakhiri mein 'great enthusiasm' (bhari josh) likha hai. Josh hamesha kisi badi jeet (won) ko manane (celebrate) ke waqt dikhta hai.
trick: 'Enthusiasm' ek positive word hai, isliye options mein se wo pair chunein jisme dono words (won, celebrated) positive feeling de rahe hon.
tip: 'Great enthusiasm' hamesha positive outcome ke baad aata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: To ensure _____ operation of the heavy industrial machine, it must be _____ regularly by an expert.
explanation: Kisi bhi machine ko bina rukaawat (smooth) chalane ke liye zaroori hai ki uski lagatar service aur maintenance ki jaye.
trick: Machine ki achhi working ke liye word 'smooth' lagta hai aur usko repair karne ya thik rakhne ko 'serviced' bolte hain.
tip: Machine maintenance ke liye 'serviced' word use karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The sudden _____ in the price of essential commodities has negatively _____ the monthly budget of middle-class families.
explanation: Zaroori chijon ke daam badhne (hike) se middle-class budget par bura asar (negatively affected) padta hai. 'Drop' hone se negatively affect nahi hota.
trick: 'Negatively' word saaf bata raha hai ki prices badhi hongi. Daam badhne ko 'hike' kehte hain.
tip: Noun 'hike' aur verb 'affected' ka sahi use karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: My uncle deals _____ imported garments and earns a handsome profit.
explanation: 'Deal' ke do main use hote hain: 'deal in' ka matlab kisi cheez ka vyapar (business) karna hota hai, aur 'deal with' ka matlab kisi insaan ya problem ko sambhalna hota hai. Yahan garments ke business ki baat hai isliye 'in' aayega.
trick: Agar aage koi goods ya business ka naam ho toh hamesha 'deal in' chunein.
tip: Deal in = Trade/Business, Deal with = Handle a person/issue.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The number of students appearing for the exam _____ increasing every year.
explanation: Grammar rule ke according, 'The number of' ke baad noun plural (students) aata hai lekin verb hamesha singular aati hai kyunki yahan focus ek definite quantity par hai. Wahi 'A number of' ke sath plural verb aati hai.
trick: 'The' definite article hai jo ek fix number ko dikhata hai, isliye iske sath hamesha singular verb (is/was/has) aayegi.
tip: 'The number of' + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: She has been working hard because she wants to get admission into _____ reputed university.
explanation: 'Reputed' word consonant sound (r) se shuru hota hai. Aur kisi ek general university ki baat ho rahi hai isliye indefinite article 'a' lagega. Agar sidha 'university' bhi hota, toh 'yu' sound ke karan 'a' hi lagta.
trick: Blank ke baad 'reputed' adjective hai, uska pehla sound check karo. 'R' vyanjan hai, toh 'a' lagega.
tip: Vyanjan (consonant) sound wale words se pehle 'a' lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: If I had known about your illness, I _____ definitely visited you in the hospital.
explanation: Ye Third Conditional sentence hai. Jab 'If' wale clause mein Past Perfect (had + v3) hota hai, toh main clause mein hamesha 'would have + v3' ka use kiya jata hai.
trick: If-clause mein 'had known' dekhte hi dusre part mein aankh band karke 'would have' dhoondo.
tip: If + Past Perfect (had+v3) = would have + v3.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Work hard diligently, lest you _____ fail the upcoming board examinations.
explanation: 'Lest' ek negative conjunction hai jiska matlab hota hai 'kahin aisa na ho ki'. Iske sath aane wale clause mein hamesha helping verb 'should' ka use hota hai, aur isme dubara 'not' nahi lagta.
trick: Sentence mein 'lest' dikhe toh aage wale hisse mein bina soche 'should' laga do. Ye fixed joda hai.
tip: Lest ke sath hamesha 'should' modal aata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: We all look forward _____ meeting you at the grand annual conference next week.
explanation: 'Look forward' ke baad hamesha preposition 'to' aata hai, aur iske turant baad verb ki 'ing' form (gerund) aati hai. Yahan 'meeting' diya hai, isliye uske pehle 'to' aayega.
trick: 'Look forward' ek fixed idiom hai, iske sath hamesha 'to' aata hai, kisi aur option ko dekhne ki zaroorat hi nahi.
tip: Fixed phrase yaad rakhein: Look forward to + V1(ing).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Let us go for a long walk by the riverside, _____?
explanation: Question Tag ka rule hai ki jab bhi sentence 'Let us' ya 'Let's' se shuru hota hai (jo suggestion deta hai), toh uska question tag hamesha 'shall we?' banta hai.
trick: Agar sentence ka pehla word 'Let's' ya 'Let us' hai, toh question tag hamesha aur hamesha 'shall we' hoga.
tip: Let's se shuru hone wale vakya ka tag 'shall we' hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The manager congratulated his team _____ their remarkable success in the recent marketing campaign.
explanation: Kisi ko badhai dene ke liye 'congratulate' ke sath hamesha preposition 'on' ka use kiya jata hai. 'For' bolne mein sahi lag sakta hai par grammar ke hisaab se galat hai.
trick: Success, victory, ya achievement ke liye congratulate ke baad sirf aur sirf 'on' aata hai.
tip: Congratulate / Compliment + on + success/achievement.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Each of the employees _____ given a special bonus for their hard work this year.
explanation: Rule ke anusar, 'Each of', 'Either of', 'Neither of' ke baad noun hamesha plural (employees) aata hai, lekin aage use hone wali verb hamesha singular hoti hai. Yahan singular verb sirf 'was' hai.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat 'Each' se ho toh subject chahe jo ho, verb singular hi dhoondni hai.
tip: Each of / One of ke baad verb hamesha singular lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: By this time next year, she _____ her master's degree in computer science.
explanation: Jab kisi future ke diye gaye samay tak koi kaam pura ho chuka hoga, toh wahan Future Perfect tense (will have + v3) ka use hota hai. 'By this time next year' iska hint hai.
trick: Sentence ke shuru mein 'By + Future Time' (jaise by next year/month) dikhe toh option mein 'will have + V3' tick karein.
tip: By + Time in Future = Future Perfect Tense.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The sudden _____ of the prominent minister left the entire political party in a state of deep _____.
explanation: Minister ke achanak koi kadam uthane se party par asar padta hai. Achanak isteefa (resignation) dene se 'shock' (sadma) lagna sabse logical aur contextual meaning de raha hai.
trick: 'Sudden' aur 'deep' words dikha rahe hain ki kuch unexpected hua hai. Resignation aur shock perfect pair banate hain.
tip: Unexpected events hamesha shock ya surprise dete hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Although the team captain is usually very _____, he became surprisingly _____ during the final match.
explanation: Conjunction 'Although' do opposite baaton ko jodta hai. Agar captain aam taur par shant (calm) rehta hai, toh match ke doran wo iska ulta (aggressive) ho gaya hoga. Baki options opposite nahi hain.
trick: First word aur second word ek dusre ke opposite (antonyms) hone chahiye kyunki 'Although' contrast dikhata hai.
tip: Although wale sentences mein opposite words ki jodi dhoondein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The local administration has decided to _____ strict measures to _____ the rising levels of air pollution.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: She was absolutely _____ to find out that she had been _____ for the prestigious overseas scholarship.
explanation: Prestigious scholarship milna ek khushi ki baat hai. Agar koi select hoga, tabhi wo thrilled (bahut khush) hoga. Devastated-rejected grammatically thik hai par 'absolutely' aur 'prestigious' positive tone de rahe hain.
trick: Positive result (scholarship) = Positive emotion (thrilled). Selection hone par hi khushi milti hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Despite his continuous _____, the young boy could not _____ the complex mathematical equation.

tip: Mathematical equation ko hamesha 'solve' kiya jata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The highly experienced detective carefully examined the _____ to _____ the real culprit behind the robbery.
explanation: Robbery (chori) ke case mein detective saboot (evidence) ko dhyaan se dekhta hai taaki wo asli mujrim ko pehchan (identify) sake. Dusre options logic-less hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The newly updated software is highly _____ and has significantly _____ the daily productivity of our team.
explanation: Agar software update hua hai, toh wo asardaar (efficient) hoga aur usse team ke kaam karne ki kshamta (productivity) badhegi (increased). Yahan positive cause aur positive effect dikhana hai.
trick: Naya update aane se cheezein behtar hoti hain, isliye dono blanks ke liye positive words (efficient, increased) chunein.
tip: Update aur productivity hamesha positive relation banate hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: To _____ a healthy and active lifestyle, one must strictly _____ eating excessively oily junk food.
explanation: Achhi health banaye rakhne (maintain) ke liye zaroori hai ki oily aur junk food khane se parhez kiya jaye (avoid). Ye ek standard health advice hai.
trick: Junk food ke aage negative action (avoid/stop) aayega aur healthy lifestyle ke aage positive action (maintain) aayega.
tip: Healthy life ke liye junk food hamesha avoid karna padta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The principal proudly _____ the top students for their _____ performance in the national level science exhibition.
explanation: Top students ne exhibition mein behtareen (outstanding) pradarshan kiya hoga, isliye principal unki taareef (praised) karega. 'Proudly' word bata raha hai ki baat positive hai.
trick: 'Proudly' (garv se) aur 'top students' hint de rahe hain ki tareef hi hui hogi, isliye 'praised' aur 'outstanding' aayenge.
tip: Sentence mein positive adverb (proudly) = positive verbs.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Due to the remarkably _____ rainfall last night, the highly anticipated outdoor concert had to be _____.
explanation: Bhari barish (heavy rainfall) ki wajah se khule maidan wala program (outdoor concert) radd (cancelled) karna pada. Ye cause and effect ka best example hai.
trick: Rainfall (barish) ke sath 'heavy' lagta hai. Aur barish aane se outdoor event rukte hain (cancelled).
tip: Heavy rain ka result outdoor events ke liye negative (cancel) hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: After the unfortunate accident, he became blind _____ his left eye.
explanation: Jab koi vyakti physically kisi ek aankh se andha hota hai, toh wahan preposition 'in' ka use kiya jata hai (blind in one eye). Agar kisi ki galti ko andekha karne ki baat ho, tab 'blind to' lagta hai.
trick: Physical blindness ke liye 'in' chunein, aur galtiyon ki taraf andha hone ke liye 'to' lagayein.
tip: Blind in the eye, blind to the faults.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: A beautiful bouquet of yellow roses _____ colour and fragrance to the entire room.
explanation: Yahan sentence ka main subject 'bouquet' (guldasta) hai, jo ki singular hai. 'Yellow roses' preposition 'of' ka object hai. Isliye singular subject ke sath singular verb 'lends' aayega.
trick: Preposition 'of' se pehle wala word real subject hota hai. 'Bouquet' ek hai, toh verb mein s/es lagega.
tip: Preposition se pehle aane wala word hi real subject hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The young prince is _____ heir to the vast property left by his late grandfather.
explanation: Word 'heir' (uttaradhikari) mein 'h' silent hota hai aur iska pronunciation 'air' (vowel sound) se shuru hota hai. Vowel sound hone ki wajah se iske pehle article 'an' lagaya jayega.
trick: Heir, hour, honest, honor - in sabhi words mein 'h' silent hota hai aur inke aage hamesha 'an' aata hai.
tip: H silent wale words par vowel sound ka rule lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Scarcely had the strict teacher entered the classroom _____ all the students stood up in silence.
explanation: English grammar ke co-relative conjunctions ke niyam ke anusar, 'Scarcely' aur 'Hardly' ke sath hamesha 'when' ka joda banta hai. 'Than' ka use 'No sooner' ke sath hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'Scarcely' ya 'Hardly' dekhte hi sidha options mein 'when' dhoondh kar tick kar dein.
tip: Hardly/Scarcely hamesha 'when' ke sath pair hote hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The newly appointed manager is very _____ and always completes his daily tasks ahead of time.
explanation: Sentence ki tone positive hai kyunki manager apna kaam waqt se pehle karta hai. Isliye mehnati (hardworking) ke liye 'diligent' word aayega. Baaki teeno words ka matlab aalsi hota hai.
trick: Agar kaam jaldi ho raha hai, toh vyakti hardworking hoga. 'Diligent' ka matlab mehnati hota hai.
tip: Diligent (mehnati) positive context ke liye use hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The brilliant scientist was completely engrossed _____ his complex experiment late at night.
explanation: 'Engrossed' ka matlab hota hai kisi kaam mein puri tarah se doob jana ya magan ho jana. Grammar mein 'engrossed' ke sath hamesha fixed preposition 'in' ka use hota hai.
trick: 'Engrossed' aur 'absorbed' dono ka matlab magan hona hota hai, aur dono ke sath 'in' hi lagta hai.
tip: Engrossed in = absorbed in = puri tarah magan hona.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: If she practices typing consistently every day, she _____ the upcoming competitive data entry test.
explanation: Ye First Conditional (Open Condition) ka sentence hai. Jab 'if' clause Present Indefinite (practices) mein hota hai, toh aage wala main clause Future Indefinite (will/shall + V1) mein hota hai.
trick: If ke sath wale hisse mein V1/V5 (present tense) dikhe toh doosre hisse mein hamesha 'will + V1' lagayein.
tip: If + Present Tense = Future Tense (will + v1).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Neither of the two highly qualified brothers _____ considered suitable for this extremely challenging job.
explanation: Grammar ka rule kehta hai ki 'Neither of', 'Either of', ya 'None of' ke baad aane wala noun ya pronoun plural hota hai (brothers), lekin aage jo verb aati hai wo hamesha singular hoti hai.
trick: Sentence ki shuruaat 'Neither of' se ho toh sirf singular verb (is/was/has) wala option hi sahi hoga.
tip: Neither of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The dying miser reluctantly parted _____ all his accumulated wealth in the end.
explanation: Phrasal verb 'part with' ka matlab hota hai kisi non-living thing (paisa, property, aadat) se alag hona ya usse tyagna. 'Part from' ka use kisi insaan se alag hone ke liye hota hai.
trick: Blank ke baad 'wealth' (nirjeev chij) hai, isliye 'part with' aayega. Agar koi insaan hota toh 'from' aata.
tip: Part with something (things), Part from someone (person).

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: It is high time you _____ preparing seriously for the upcoming final examinations.
explanation: Ek pakka grammar rule hai ki 'It is time' ya 'It is high time' ke baad agar koi subject (jaise 'you') aata hai, toh uske turant baad aane wali verb hamesha Past Indefinite (V2) form mein hoti hai.
trick: Sentence ke shuru mein 'It is high time' dekh kar sidha option mein V2 (verb ki second form) dhoondhein.
tip: It is high time + Subject + V2 (Past Indefinite).

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The ruling government's sudden decision to _____ taxes on essential goods has _____ a lot of public anger.
explanation: Zaroori chijon par tax badhane (increase) se hi aam janta mein gussa bhadkega (provoked). Agar tax kam (decrease) hota, toh gussa shant (calmed) ho jata, par word 'anger' ke sath 'calmed' logic nahi banata.
trick: Public anger (gussa) hamesha kisi negative policy ki wajah se bhadakta (provoked) hai. Tax increase negative hai.
tip: Cause (tax badhna) aur uska logical effect (gussa aana) match karein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Despite his _____ wealth and fame, the old man leads a surprisingly _____ lifestyle in a small village.
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast dikhata hai. Yani ki uske paas bahut zyada (immense) paisa hai, fir bhi wo ek bohot hi sadharan (simple) zindagi jeeta hai. Baki options mein virodhabhas nahi hai.
trick: 'Despite' word wale sentence mein dono blanks mein ek dusre se opposite sense dene wale words lagayein.
tip: Despite virodhabhas (contrast) banata hai, isliye opposite logic dhoondein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: She politely _____ the grand dinner invitation because she was heavily _____ with some critical office work.
explanation: Agar koi kisi zaruri kaam mein vyast (occupied) hai, toh wo natural si baat hai ki invitation ko mana karega ya thukrayega (declined). 'Because' ke baad reason diya hai.
trick: 'Because' se pehle aur baad ke events ka connection dekhein. Kaam mein busy hona = invitation decline karna.
tip: Reason (vyast hona) aur Result (mana karna) ka sahi pair chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The unexpected _____ of the revolutionary new technology has completely _____ the way we communicate daily.
explanation: Nayi technology ke aane (advent) se hamari communication ki duniya puri tarah badal gayi hai (transformed). 'Advent' ka matlab aagman ya shuruaat hota hai.
trick: Technology ke aane se society mein positive badlaav aata hai, isliye 'advent' aur 'transformed' sabse best set hain.
tip: Nayi technology aane (advent) par cheezein transform hoti hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: He was happily _____ from the city hospital after a rapid and full _____ from his deadly illness.

tip: Hospital aur illness ke context mein recovery aur discharge chunein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The strict and disciplined manager did not _____ any kind of deviation from the _____ company rules.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Many ancient people truly _____ that the earth was totally flat before modern science finally _____ it wrong.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The incredibly brave frontline soldier was proudly _____ with a special national medal for his outstanding _____ in the battlefield.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Every citizen must strictly comply _____ the rules and regulations of the country.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: My elder brother is _____ M.L.A. from our local constituency.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: I completely differ _____ you on this important political issue.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: Due to the sudden heavy rainfall, the management had to put _____ the cricket match.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: If I _____ a millionaire, I would open a free hospital for the poor.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The brave soldier was awarded a gallantry medal _____ his heroic act in the war.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: We had hardly reached the railway platform _____ the Rajdhani Express arrived.

trick: Sentence ki shuruaat ya middle mein 'hardly' dikhe, toh seedha option mein 'when' dhoondho.
tip: Hardly / Scarcely + when ek fix pair hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The sudden death of the beloved leader came as a huge shock _____ the entire nation.
explanation: 'Shock' ya 'surprise' ke baad jab koi destination ya receiver (poora desh) hota hai, toh preposition 'to' ka use hota hai. 'A shock to someone' ek standard phrase hai.
trick: Kisi ko sadma lagne ke context mein hamesha 'a shock to' bola jata hai. 'Shock for' informal hai.
tip: Hamesha 'came as a shock to' phrase ka use hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option. || Question: The teacher made the mischievous boys _____ on the bench outside the classroom.
explanation: Causative verb 'make' (ya made) ke baad active voice mein hamesha bare infinitive (verb ki first form bina 'to' ke) aati hai. Isliye sirf 'stand' sahi hoga.
trick: Make, let, bid jaise words ke baad hamesha V1 aata hai. 'To + V1' kabhi use mat karna.
tip: Make ke baad hamesha Bare Infinitive (V1) aata hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: By the time we finally _____ the cinema hall, the blockbuster movie had already _____.
explanation: Jab past mein do action hote hain, toh pehla action Past Perfect (had + v3) aur dusra Past Indefinite (v2) mein hota hai. Hum pahuche (reached) aur movie pehle hi shuru (started) ho chuki thi.
trick: 'Had already' ke baad V3 aata hai. Yahan 'started' V3 hai. Dusre options fit nahi baithte.
tip: Past ka past = Past Perfect (had + V3) hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Although the famous businessman is incredibly _____, he lives a very _____ life in a small town.
explanation: 'Although' conjunction ek contrast (virodhabhas) banata hai. Agar koi ameer (wealthy) hai, toh use lavish life jeeni chahiye, par contrast ki wajah se wo sadharan (simple) life jeeta hai.
trick: 'Although' dikhte hi opposite situations dhoondho. Ameer aadmi ka sadharan jivan jeena ek contrast hai.
tip: Although wale sentence mein opposite concepts ka joda banta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The manager decided to _____ the new candidate because she was highly _____ and experienced.
explanation: 'Because' reason batata hai. Agar candidate experienced aur kaabil (efficient) hai, toh manager use job par rakhega (hire karega). Positive qualities par positive result milta hai.
trick: Second blank mein 'experienced' ke sath ek aur positive word (efficient) aayega. Aur achhi quality par hire karte hain, fire nahi.
tip: Positive reason (efficient) ka positive result (hire) hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: She was extremely _____ to find that her expensive diamond ring was _____ from her locker.

trick: Expensive cheez agar locker se 'missing' ho toh emotion 'shocked' aayega. Baki options senseless hain.
tip: Mehngi cheez khone par negative emotion (shocked) lagayein.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The honest clerk respectfully _____ for his silly mistake during the _____ staff meeting.
explanation: Galti (mistake) hone par insaan maafi mangta hai (apologized). Meeting subah (morning) ho sakti hai. Baaki pairs mistake aur meeting ke context mein totally irrelevant hain.
trick: 'Mistake' word aate hi dimag mein 'apologize' (maafi mangna) aana chahiye. Second option automatically set ho jayega.
tip: Mistake ke sath hamesha 'apologize' verb suit karta hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: Despite his _____ age, the retired grandfather runs very _____ every morning in the park.
explanation: 'Despite' (ke bawajood) contrast show karta hai. Retired hone ka matlab old age hai, aur umar jyada hone ke bawajood wo tej (fast) daudte hain.
trick: Retired grandfather hamesha 'old' age ke honge. 'Despite' contrast deta hai, toh budhape ke bawajood 'fast' daudna sahi joda hai.
tip: Despite words hamesha contrast (old-fast) banate hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The concerned doctor _____ some effective antibiotics to quickly cure the stubborn _____.
explanation: Doctor dawaiyan (antibiotics) humesha likh kar deta hai jise 'prescribe' kehte hain. Dawaiyan kisi bimari ya 'infection' ko theek (cure) karne ke liye hoti hain.
trick: Doctor dawai bechta (sold) nahi, prescribe karta hai. Bas ye ek word dekhte hi option clear ho jayega.
tip: Doctor ke nuskhe ko English mein prescribe karna kehte hain.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The heavily loaded truck is _____ big to _____ through this narrow wooden bridge.
explanation: Grammar mein 'too...to' ka ek fix pair hota hai, jo ek negative limit batata hai (itna bada ki guzar nahi sakta). Pul ke aar-paar jane ke liye 'pass through' use hota hai.
trick: Sentence mein 'to _____ through' likha hai. 'To' se pehle wala adverb hamesha 'too' hoga (too big to pass).
tip: 'too + adjective + to + v1' ek fixed grammar structure hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: The massive earthquake completely _____ the ancient temple, leaving the villagers in sheer _____.
explanation: Bhookamp (earthquake) mandir ko tabah (destroy) kar dega, jisse gaon walo ko bhari dukh ya nirasha (despair) hogi. Earthquake negative hai, isliye options negative chahiye.
trick: Earthquake aane par tabahi aati hai. 'Destroyed' negative word hai aur 'despair' (dukh) uska result hai.
tip: Earthquake ka effect hamesha negative aur destructive hota hai.

question: Direction: Fill in the blanks with the most appropriate pair of words. || Question: To effectively _____ air pollution, the city council has decided to _____ strict traffic rules.

trick: Rules hamesha lagoo kiye jate hain (implement). Pollution ko humesha ghatane (reduce) ki koshish ki jati hai.
tip: Problem ko reduce karte hain, aur rules ko implement karte hain.
